name: css_anim_perf_transition
description: PAINT-ONLY TRANSITION TICKS PATCH THE DISPLAY LIST, THEY DO NOT REBUILD IT. `animation: color 1s linear` walks the text colour red->blue; each tick must rewrite the transitioning node's DL items in place (dl_rebuilds stays 0 after the counter reset) and the DL diff turns exactly those items into damage - bounded rects, never a full-frame repaint. This is the difference between 'cheap on small docs' and 'cheap, period': a rebuild re-emits every item of a big document per tick, a patch touches one node.

html: The colour of this text animates
Filler content so the label is a small part of the frame and a full repaint is distinguishable from a patched one by area.
css: html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
#label { color: #ff0000; font-size: 16px; height: 40px; animation: color 1s linear; }
